label: copy-phase input x (fed-back) when next output is x or e, early recall
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the fed-back input token is x (100% of activations; never in the original phase or at <DEL>). Within that, it is concentrated where the token being output is x (73% of mass, i.e. the first x of a doubled xx pair) or e (21%), at recall_idx 2-3 (86% of mass), and not when the previous input was also x. Strongest examples are xx pairs at original positions 1-3 (e.g. z a x x ... <DEL> z a [x] x). Precision is low (~0.16): most x->x / x->e transitions in the copy phase with the same context do not activate it, and I found no simple history variable separating them, so the feature is a sparse, inconsistent detector of an x copy step followed by x/e.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=x (+2.74), phase=2 & out_tok=x (+2.69), in_tok=x (+2.58), phase=2 & out_tok=e (+2.39), out_tok=x (+2.31), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=x (+2.25). Lower it: prev_tok=0 (-1.99), next_out=- (-1.94), orig5=y (-1.71), next_out=v (-1.52).
